person_made_it: It starts from Alan's own Oct 7 reply and Gordon's real thank-you, and every teammate line comes from Gordon's records, not a template.
emcee_who_is_speaking: Gordon's team speaks, warmly, in the FINAL BOSS voice Alan already met through his secret button; the walk-on announcer is a playful tap-only extra.
what_time_of_day_is_this_room: Night: a dark locker room under one warm spotlight, with his jersey hanging in it.
did_the_click_pay_me: Picking a number draws it on his jersey in the team's own numerals and writes it into his I'M IN email; the walk-on button says his name.
works_for_the_recipient: A busy executive gets the whole ask in the first screen: what, when, one-reply yes, the Nov 1 date, and a kind way to say no.
taught_me_something: It shows how big the Sin City Classic is (20th year, 24 sports, 10K+ athletes) and how the team trains first-timers like Matt.
told_me_the_truth: Team status is stated plainly (5 of 8 registered as of Oct 19), every festival figure is cited, and nothing promises a price or a launch date.
weakest: The festival-scale band and day cards still read close to a standard card layout; next I would make the schedule a single court-line timeline.
